title: When replying to, forwarding, or editing a crafted email message as new, Thunderbird could embed parts of a different…
description: A vulnerability in Thunderbird allowed parts of a different email message stored in the same folder to be embedded into a reply, forwarded, or edited message without showing a blocked content warning. If the user sent the message, the content of the other message was disclosed to the recipients. This issue was fixed in Thunderbird versions 159 and 153.6.
